heroHeadline: CDMX: Rent Cap Reform, World Cup Prep, and a City Still Sinking
heroSubtitle: Brugada's constitutional rent-cap reform moves through Congress as NASA NISAR satellites confirm extreme land subsidence; BTS tours the Estadio GNP while the Metro Line 12 anniversary passes with still zero convictions.
footerNote: Data sourced from official CDMX government reports (Gobierno CDMX, SSC, SACMEX, SEMOVI, CAMe), INEGI, CONAGUA, Fiscalía CDMX, Congreso CDMX, NASA, La Jornada, El Universal, Proceso, Milenio, Infobae, Reuters, AP, and institutional analyses from UNAM, IMCO, and México Evalúa.
